description: A structural (setting-out) grid for the whole building: numbered lines 1, 2, 3… running north–south at xSpacings (mm, between consecutive lines, eastwards from origin) and lettered lines A, B, C… (no I or O) running east–west at ySpacings (northwards). origin = where lines 1 and A cross (plan mm). Every floor plan shows it with bubbles; it isn't on a level. Typical car park spans: 8400 (three 2400 bays between columns) or 7800–8100. numbers/letters override the labels. Place columns on its crossings.

extension.description: mm the lines run past the outer lines, default 1500

origin.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level

xSpacings.description: mm between consecutive numbered lines; [] for just line 1

ySpacings.description: mm between consecutive lettered lines; [] for just line A

name: create_grid
title: Add structural grid
